title: Examining gaps in institutional policies for clinical genomic data sharing: A cross-jurisdictional study.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: no PMCID, not open access in Europe PMC, no supplement, no accessions, no NCBI links, no Zenodo/Dryad hits. No data files exist to open.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: From the abstract only: a mixed-methods content analysis of data-sharing and privacy policies from 33 clinical genomic institutions in 17 countries/regions, coded by two reviewers.

a1_downloadable.note: No deposited dataset, supplement or repository link found; paper is paywalled with no full text in Europe PMC (checked via paper_context.py).

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No prediction target exists; the study is a qualitative policy review, any 'label' would have to be built by hand-coding policy documents.

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs would be policy documents, not deposited; nothing checked in files.

a5_enough_rows.note: 33 institutions (from abstract), far below the ~400-row minimum for classification.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Would be tiny if it existed.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No files to compare against the paper's counts.

a8_label_provenance.note: Any label would be subjective reviewer coding of policy text, not a physical measurement.

honest_claim_h3: No ML claim is possible: 33 hand-coded policy documents, not deposited, with no measured outcome.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use the text of institutional privacy policies to predict whether they clearly define rules for sharing genetic data without consent.
plain_idea.train_on: Policy documents from 33 clinical genomics institutions (count from abstract; documents not deposited).
plain_idea.predict: Whether each governance element is clearly specified, as hand-coded by two reviewers.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Could help audit policies at scale, but 33 subjective examples cannot train or validate such a model.

ml_idea: None viable; at most a text-classification of policy documents, but n=33 and no deposited data.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Check for a deposited coding table: none found in Europe PMC, NCBI, Zenodo or Dryad.

verdict_reason: Qualitative policy review of 33 institutions with no deposited data, no measured label, and far too few rows for ML.
